purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: Card Networks and Stablecoins — 2026
question: What have Visa, Mastercard and the new Open USD coin actually launched with stablecoins, and how much money really moves that way?
bluf: Stablecoin cards are real but still tiny: Visa's stablecoin-linked cards carried about $5.2 billion of 2025 spending, 0.04% of Visa's $14.2 trillion total. Mastercard settles live only in USDC (other coins are announced), and its BVNK purchase closed August 3, so the July files are outdated on that point. Open USD (OUSD) launched September 30, issued by Bridge Building Inc. (a Stripe company) and founded with Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe and Visa; about 91% of its supply sat on Stripe's Tempo chain, and it had no independent reserve attestation yet.
evidence_cutoff_note: Card-network product lines read as of July 29; the Open USD launch map is current through September 30.
use_note: Catalog entry added 2026-10-03 (crypto hub clean-up) so this work can be found on its own; its files stay where they are and remain members of the parent study.
